goal: The harness streams SDK messages and telemetry events to the run's TelemetrySink (with domain events mirrored as lines) instead of the store, and a sink append failure never aborts or finalizes the attempt.

references: .flywheel/specs/00010-FEATURE-message-granular-audit-stream.md -- the per-message cadence and on_message composition this task retargets from store to sink
constraints: Spec FR-3, FR-4, and FR-7 are authoritative
Per-message cadence is preserved: each SDK message is appended to the sink as it arrives, before the iteration completes

Domain events are appended to the store FIRST (the row is authoritative) and then mirrored to the sink; telemetry-category append_event store calls and sdk-message store writes are removed from the harness
Sink failure semantics: record the first failure once (stderr) and continue the run silently thereafter; domain-event and lifecycle write failures keep today's INTERNAL_ERROR finalization exactly

The existing strict audit-failure tests in packages/flywheel-core/tests/test_harness.py pin the old store-write path and the old fatal-telemetry behavior -- update them to the new split semantics in the same commit, and sweep every other test asserting harness-to-store telemetry or sdk-message writes
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: Do not remove store protocol verbs or schema tables -- that is the schema-reduction task
Do not retarget the TUI or audit readers -- they may be temporarily blind to live telemetry within this phase
edge_cases: A run that produces zero SDK messages must still work; the file may contain only domain mirrors
A sink that raises on the very first append must not prevent lifecycle seeding or attempt finalization
